evals.prompt: /research what's new with the Bun JavaScript runtime --quick
evals.expected_output: Precondition: a SearXNG MCP server is connected (the user-scope searxng server or the repertoire-searxng plugin) and its instance answers. A NEWS report at quick depth: the skill checks SearXNG with ToolSearch and searxng_instance_info before anything else, runs the script from the skill folder, dispatches 6 subagents in one message through the Agent tool with the fully qualified SearXNG tools, and the stats footer says the search backend was SearXNG.
expectations: ToolSearch is run with the query 'searxng' before any subagent is dispatched
mcp__searxng__searxng_instance_info or mcp__plugin_repertoire-searxng_searxng__searxng_instance_info is called before any search tool
The script is run from the skill's own folder (the resolved ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/research.py) with --quick, never through a ~/.claude/skills/research or .claude/skills/research path
Exactly 6 subagents (C1-C3 and O1-O3) are dispatched in a single message through the Agent tool, and no Task or TaskOutput tool is called
Every subagent prompt names the SearXNG tools with their server prefix (mcp__searxng__ or mcp__plugin_repertoire-searxng_searxng__), including web_url_read and searxng_search_suggestions
QUERY_TYPE is NEWS, and the NEWS subagents are told to pass time_range month
The report has the community section, the official section, and a cross-reference table with 3-5 rows marked Aligned, Divergent, or Gap
The stats footer has a line 'Search backend: SearXNG (...)' naming the fully qualified searxng_web_search tool
The report ends with the follow-up invitation (NEWS with no target tool), not a prompt offer or a target-tool question, and then waits for the user

evals.prompt: /research best open-source vector databases for RAG
evals.expected_output: Precondition: no SearXNG tool is available in the session (no searxng server and no repertoire-searxng plugin, as in a cloud Cowork session with no linked computer), or its instance is stopped. A RECOMMENDATIONS report at default depth whose subagents use WebSearch and WebFetch, and whose footer names that fallback, its reason, and the SearXNG setup reference.
expectations: ToolSearch is run with the query 'searxng' before any subagent is dispatched
No SearXNG search tool (mcp__searxng__searxng_web_search or mcp__plugin_repertoire-searxng_searxng__searxng_web_search) is called
Exactly 8 subagents (C1-C4 and O1-O4) are dispatched in a single message through the Agent tool
Every subagent prompt carries the WebSearch + WebFetch search block with the recorded reason, and none lists SearXNG tools
The stats footer has a line 'Search backend: WebSearch + WebFetch (fallback: no SearXNG tool)' or '(fallback: SearXNG not reachable)'
A line under the footer points to references/searxng-setup.md
The community section is a 'Most Mentioned' list of specific database names with mention counts and sources
The report ends with the follow-up invitation (RECOMMENDATIONS with no target tool), not a prompt offer or a target-tool question

evals.prompt: /research how are teams adopting the Model Context Protocol in production
evals.expected_output: Precondition: OPENAI_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY are unset and no ~/.config/research/.env exists. The script runs web-only without network calls; the skill continues without warning, lets the subagents cover the web (Reddit included, since the script covered nothing), and the footer drops the Reddit and X lines, keeps the search backend line, and gives the environment-variable hint.
expectations: The script output shows 'Mode: web-only' and 'Script covered: none', and the skill continues to Phase 2 without stopping or warning
The skill does not run a separate web search of its own in response to the '### WEBSEARCH REQUIRED ###' block; web sources come from the subagents
The community subagent prompts say the script covered no sites, so Reddit threads are in scope
The stats footer has no Reddit line and no X line, and still has a 'Search backend:' line naming SearXNG or WebSearch + WebFetch
The footer hint names OPENAI_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY as environment variables and describes ~/.config/research/.env as a Claude Code convenience that Cowork lacks
No API key value appears anywhere in the output

evals.prompt: /research what are people saying about the Zed editor lately --quick
evals.expected_output: Precondition: only XAI_API_KEY is set (OPENAI_API_KEY unset, no ~/.config/research/.env). The script runs in x-only mode and covers X only, so Reddit is left to the community subagents. The footer keeps the X line, drops the Reddit line, and keeps the search backend line.
expectations: The script output shows 'Mode: x-only' and 'Script covered: x.com, twitter.com', and the skill continues to Phase 2 without stopping
The C2 subagent prompt puts Reddit in scope, because reddit.com is not in SCRIPT_SOURCES
No subagent prompt asks for x.com or twitter.com to be searched
Exactly 6 subagents (C1-C3 and O1-O3) are dispatched in a single message through the Agent tool
The stats footer has an X line and a 'Search backend:' line, and no Reddit line
No API key value appears anywhere in the output
